scene utalovehotel1
Or at least safe-{i}ish.{/i}
lines.zh: 或者至少算是安全——{i}吧{/i}。

lines.en: : Man, just how many fluids am I going to get all over my clothes before the end of the day?
lines.zh: : 天啊，今天过完之前，我到底还要往衣服上沾多少种液体啊？

lines.en: : Don’t you think saying something like that might be a little too...{i}suggestive{/i} considering where we are right now?
lines.zh: : 考虑到我们现在所在的地方，您不觉得说这种话有点太……{i}暧昧{/i}了吗？

lines.en: scene utalovehotel2
: Obviously. But, more important than that-
lines.zh: : 显然是。不过比这更重要的是——

lines.en: scene utalovehotel3
: What the heck is up with this cliche?!
lines.zh: : 这老套的桥段到底是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Taking shelter from the rain in a love hotel?! Since when is this an anime?!
lines.zh: : 在情人酒店里躲雨？！这什么时候变成动画了？！

lines.en: : And just how crazy do they expect us to get?! There are like five hundred condoms on that bed!
lines.zh: : 他们还指望我们疯到什么程度？！那张床上摆了差不多五百个避孕套！

lines.en: : That’s five hundred more than I’d ever intend to use, so...
lines.zh: : 比我打算用的多了五百个，所以……

lines.en: scene utalovehotel4
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : What? Am I not allowed to dislike condoms?
lines.zh: : 怎么？我难道还不能讨厌避孕套了？

lines.en: : Did you plan this? Were all of those buildings you tried going into before this one {i}actually{/i} locked? Or were you just holding out hope that we’d come across somewhere like this eventually?
lines.zh: : 您是计划好的吧？您来这儿之前试着进的那些楼，{i}真的{/i}都锁着吗？还是您一直憋着希望我们最后能撞上这么个地方？

lines.en: : You got me. I also summoned the rain with my magical, pervert powers.
lines.zh: : 被您识破了。那雨也是我用魔法变态力量召唤来的。

lines.en: : I {i}knew{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 我{i}就知道{/i}。

lines.en: : Anyway, I guess we have to have sex now.
lines.zh: : 总之，看来我们现在非做爱不可了。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel5
: No way, no way, no way! A love hotel for my first time?! That sounds like something Kirin would do!
lines.zh: : 不行不行不行！我的第一次要在情人酒店？！这听起来像是 Kirin 会干的事！

lines.en: : No comment.
lines.zh: : 无可奉告。

lines.en: : I’m just not ready! Especially not with the guy my best friend likes!
lines.zh: : 我只是还没准备好！尤其是跟我最好的朋友喜欢的那个男人！

lines.en: : But you’re already so wet.
lines.zh: : 可您已经这么湿了。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel6
: How do you know that?!
lines.zh: : 您怎么知道的？！

lines.en: : I was talking about the rain.
lines.zh: : 我说的是雨。

lines.en: : Oh!
scene utalovehotel7
: Uhh...
: Me too!
lines.zh: : 我也是！

lines.en: : Sensei, all I can hear are other people getting it on. We’re going to have to keep talking or I’m at risk of being tainted forever.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我满耳朵都是别人在做爱的声音。我们得一直说话，不然我有被永久玷污的风险。

lines.en: : If you’re going to act so weird about taking shelter in a love hotel, how come you’re the one who paid for it?
lines.zh: : 您要对在情人酒店躲雨这么别扭，那怎么付钱的是您？

lines.en: scene utalovehotel8
: Because you spent all of your money on me and couldn’t afford it! Also, I didn’t think they’d let me {i}actually{/i} pay! There’s no way I look old enough to check into a place like this!
lines.zh: : 因为您把钱都花在我身上了，付不起！而且我没想到他们真会让我{i}付{/i}钱！我看上去怎么都不像够年龄入住这种地方的人吧！

lines.en: : If you keep yelling, you’re going to ruin the mood for all of the people who actually came here to, you know, have sex.
lines.zh: : 您再这么嚷嚷，就要把那些真的来这儿……您知道的，做爱的人的气氛全毁了。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel9
: That is seriously so many condoms.
lines.zh: : 这避孕套是真的多。

lines.en: : They’re probably trying to offload a massive stockpile that’s been around since before all the men were drafted.
lines.zh: : 他们大概是在清仓，那批存货早在所有男人被征召入伍之前就堆在那儿了。

lines.en: : They want us to have sex with three year old condoms? There’s no way that’s up to code.
lines.zh: : 他们想让我们用放了三年的避孕套做爱？这绝对不合规吧。

lines.en: : If you go complain, we might be able to get some of my money back.
lines.zh: : 您要是去投诉，说不定能拿回一些我的钱。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel10
: {i}My{/i} money.
lines.zh: : 是{i}我的{/i}钱。

lines.en: : We all know whose money it really is.
lines.zh: : 那钱到底是谁的，大家心里都清楚。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel11
: Hah...No, it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 哈……不，没关系。

lines.en: : I’m soaking wet and cold and don’t wanna bother going back out into the lobby since they might try to card me.
lines.zh: : 我浑身湿透又冷，也不想再跑回前台去了，他们说不定会要我出示身份证。

lines.en: : I have no idea how I’d even {i}start{/i} explaining that to my parents.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道该怎么跟我爸妈{i}开口{/i}解释这事。

lines.en: : I bet you’re feeling like a real idiot for leaving your other clothes behind now, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 我猜您现在一定觉得自己把另一套衣服落下真是个大傻瓜，对吧？

lines.en: scene utalovehotel12
: You know, Sensei, I’m pretty sure there are rules against inviting a girl to a love hotel if you’re just going to poke fun at her the entire time.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我说，您把女孩请进情人酒店、结果全程都在取笑她，这应该是违反什么规定的吧。

lines.en: : Sure. Except I didn’t actually {i}invite{/i} you. So technically I can do whatever I want so long as I’m not breaking any laws.
lines.zh: : 当然有。只不过我其实并没有{i}邀请{/i}您。所以严格来说，只要不犯法，我想干什么都行。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel13
: Yeah, I think it may be a little too late for that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我看现在说这个已经有点太晚了。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t happen to have any spare clothes in those oversized man-pockets of yours, would you?
lines.zh: : 您那超大号的男人口袋里，该不会正好有套换洗衣服吧？

lines.en: : I would not. But if we’re both cold, I heard something about-
lines.zh: : 没有。不过如果我们俩都冷的话，我听说有个办法——

lines.en: : If you seriously suggest getting naked and sharing body heat right now I’m going to death beam you.
lines.zh: : 您要是真敢现在提议脱光了互相取暖，我就用死亡射线射您。

lines.en: : There’s...a {i}death{/i} beam now?
lines.zh: : 现在还有{i}死亡{/i}射线了？

lines.en: : I have tons of beams for tons of occasions. I’ve just only showed you the flavor one so far.
lines.zh: : 我有各种各样的射线，应对各种各样的场合。只不过目前为止我只给您看过口味那一种。

lines.en: : There’s no “heat beam” or “drying beam” is there?
lines.zh: : 那没有“加热射线”或者“烘干射线”吗？

lines.en: : I haven’t yet mastered those, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，那两种我还没练成。

lines.en: : What are we supposed to do then? Just stand here, not having sex, and freezing our asses off?
lines.zh: : 那我们该怎么办？就这么站着，不做爱，把屁股冻僵？

lines.en: scene utalovehotel14
: I mean...there {i}is{/i} a bathtub. And it looks like there’s a shower too. The only issue is that the glass is see through and...yeah.
lines.zh: : 我是说……这里{i}确实有{/i}个浴缸。看起来还有淋浴。唯一的问题是玻璃是透明的，然后……嗯。

lines.en: : Do you...want to shower together?
lines.zh: : 您……想一起洗吗？

lines.en: scene utalovehotel15
: What?! Absolutely not! I was just saying that if {i}you{/i} want to take a bath or something, I can just close my eyes or...watch videos on my phone until you’re done.
lines.zh: : 什么？！绝对不行！我只是说如果您{i}自己{/i}想泡个澡什么的，我可以闭上眼睛，或者……在手机上看视频，等您洗完。

lines.en: : At least that way you wouldn’t be cold anymore.
lines.zh: : 至少那样您就不会冷了。

lines.en: : I feel like this is the part where I’m supposed to be a gentleman and insist that you go first but, honestly, that sounds good and I’m probably going to take you up on it.
lines.zh: : 我感觉按理说这时候我该当个绅士，坚持让您先洗，不过说实话，这主意听起来不错，我大概就这么办了。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel13
: Don’t you think you might be a little {i}too{/i} carefree sometimes, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 您不觉得自己有时候{i}太{/i}没心没肺了吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : That means nothing from a girl who spent her hard earned money getting the two of us a room in a love hotel.
lines.zh: : 这话从一个把辛苦赚来的钱花在开情人酒店房间的女孩嘴里说出来，一点说服力都没有。

lines.en: : Make up your gosh darn mind about whose money it is already.
lines.zh: : 您倒是快点想清楚那到底是谁的钱啊。

lines.en: : Fine. It’s mine. Now, give the rest of it back or I’m going to go see if the couple next door wants to come and join us for a foursome.
lines.zh: : 行。是我的。现在把剩下的还我，不然我就去问问隔壁那对想不想过来一起玩个四人情。

lines.en: : That’s a whole lot of people and not a lot of Uta.
lines.zh: : 那可人太多了，Uta 太少了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I wouldn’t be open to sharing you anyway.
lines.zh: : 别担心。反正我也不打算把您分出去。

lines.en: : So you can take, but you won’t give. I see how it is.
lines.zh: : 所以您只进不出。我明白了。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel16
: I’ll tell you what...tonight’s {i}clearly{/i} been a slog for both of us, so...
lines.zh: : 这样吧……今晚对我们俩来说{i}显然{/i}都很煎熬，所以……

lines.en: : How ‘bout you get into that bathroom...
lines.zh: : 您去那个浴室里……

lines.en: : Take off all of your clothes...
lines.zh: : 把衣服全脱了……

lines.en: : And let me swap places with Uta-chan one more time so she can provide a little...{i}special{/i} service to make your night {i}that{/i} much better...
lines.zh: : 然后让我再跟 Uta 酱换一次班，好让她提供一点……{i}特别{/i}服务，让您的夜晚变得{i}更{/i}美好一些……

lines.en: : That sounds great. Now tell me how this “special service” is going to differ from what I want it to be.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。那么告诉我，这个“特别服务”跟我想要的版本有什么不同。

lines.en: : Well, I can’t just tell you while you still have all of your clothes on, Master.
lines.zh: : 嗯，您衣服还穿着呢，我可不能就这么告诉您，Master。

lines.en: : I really wish I could bring myself to believe that there is any hope for sexual gratification in those words, but I just really can’t at this point.
lines.zh: : 我真希望自己能相信这番话里还有哪怕一丝性方面的希望，可我实在做不到。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you have broken me.
lines.zh: : 因为您把我弄坏了。

lines.en: : Then I guess I’ll just have to be {i}really{/i} gentle when I’m putting you back together, won’t I?
lines.zh: : 那我想，我把您重新拼回去的时候，就只能{i}非常{/i}温柔了，对吧？

lines.en: : God damn it.
lines.zh: : 该死。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel17

: Don’t forget to make sure all of the surfaces are properly wiped down first! This is a sketchy hotel and it would be a real shame if Uta-chan were to be sullied by {i}another{/i} surprise fluid tonight!
lines.zh: : 别忘了先把所有台面都好好擦一遍！这家酒店可疑得很，要是 Uta 酱今晚再被{i}另外一种{/i}意外的液体弄脏，那可太惨了！

lines.en: : Keep talking and I’ll give you all of the “surprise fluid” you’ll ever need.
lines.zh: : 您再说下去，我就让您要多少“意外液体”有多少。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel18
: {i}Oh my God...what am I doing?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我的天……我到底在干什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to just take a bath together? You-
lines.zh: : 您确定不想干脆一起泡个澡吗？您——

lines.en: scene utalovehotel19
: Yup!
lines.zh: : 确定！

lines.en: : And I know that saying this will probably have the reverse effect, but please don’t look over here for the next thirty seconds! I have to do something really quick!
lines.zh: : 而且我知道说了多半会起反效果，不过接下来三十秒请别往这边看！我得赶紧做点事！

lines.en: scene black
I fill the bath with water, making sure its warm before stripping down and getting inside.
lines.zh: 我往浴缸里放满水，确认水温合适，然后脱光衣服泡了进去。

lines.en: I also defy all expectations and don’t look Uta’s way for the full thirty seconds I promised to abstain for.
lines.zh: 我也出乎所有人意料地信守承诺，整整三十秒都没往 Uta 那边看。

lines.en: At second thirty-one, though, you can bet your ass that’s exactly where I looked.
lines.zh: 不过到了第三十一秒，您可以打包票，我的目光准落在那儿了。

lines.en: Unfortunately, by then, she was finished with whatever she needed to do...and so I turn my gaze back to the water as she makes her way across the room and over to me.
lines.zh: 可惜那时候，她要做的事已经做完了……于是当她穿过房间朝我走来时，我把目光转回了水面。

lines.en: : So...are you ready for your {i}special service,{/i} Master?
lines.zh: : 那么……您准备好接受您的{i}特别服务{/i}了吗，Master？

lines.en: : Ready to be disappointed, you mean? Yes.
lines.zh: : 您是说准备好失望了吗？是的。

lines.en: : Don’t get testy with me. Do you have any idea how many people would kill for what you’re about to experience?
lines.zh: : 别跟我使性子。您知道有多少人会为了您接下来要体验的东西去杀人吗？

lines.en: : Up until now, I’ve only done this for my family.
lines.zh: : 到目前为止，我只给家人做过这个。

lines.en: : Okay, well that just means my opinion of you is going to change dramatically if this actually does wind up being sexual.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那也就是说，如果这最后真的跟性有关，我对您的看法会大为改观。

lines.en: : Master, please. If it’s incest you’re looking for, you’re going to need to come back during the morning shift and ask for the one with twintails. She’ll have what you need for sure.
lines.zh: : Master，拜托。您要是找的是乱伦，那得早班的时候再来，找那个梳双马尾的。她身上保证有您想要的东西。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel20
: Wow, what a surprise. Something completely G-rated.
lines.zh: : 哇，真意外。完全是全年龄向的东西。

lines.en: : Oh, hush. You know you’re enjoying this.
lines.zh: : 哦，别嚷嚷。您知道您很享受。

lines.en: : Besides, you should be happy since the last person I did this for died of brain cancer and you’re still alive and kicking.
lines.zh: : 再说，您该高兴才对——上一个我这么做的人死于脑癌，而您还活蹦乱跳的。

lines.en: : Yeah, that makes me feel great.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这让我感觉棒极了。

lines.en: : On a serious note, though...just relax, Master. Let your worries wash away.
lines.zh: : 不过说正经的……放松就好，Master。让您的烦恼都随水冲走。

lines.en: : It must be so nice finally being out of the cold, huh? Can you feel your body warming back up?
lines.zh: : 终于不用挨冻了，一定很舒服吧？您能感觉到身子在回暖吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. But it does feel a little bad knowing that you’re still soaking wet when you should be in my place right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过知道您还浑身湿透，而本该待在水里的是您，这让我有点过意不去。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel21
: Yeah, uhh...
lines.zh: : 是啊，呃……

lines.en: : Probably not a good idea for me to take my clothes off in here.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿脱衣服大概不是什么好主意。

lines.en: : Do you not trust me?
lines.zh: : 您不相信我？

lines.en: : Uhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : But whether or not I trust you isn’t really the problem.
lines.zh: : 可问题其实不在于我信不信您。

lines.en: : What is the problem then?
lines.zh: : 那问题是什么？

lines.en: scene utalovehotel22
: Can’t say this sounds like letting your troubles wash away, Master.
lines.zh: : Master，这话听起来可不像是在让您的烦恼随水冲走啊。

lines.en: : Just “Sensei” is fine right now. I like being called “Master” and all, but I’d like for this to be a memory between Uta and me. Not Uta-{i}chan{/i} and me.
lines.zh: : 现在叫我“Sensei”就好。被人叫“Master”我当然喜欢，不过我希望这是一段属于 Uta 和我之间的回忆。而不是 Uta{i}酱{/i}和我之间的。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel23
: (Screaming internally and also horny)
lines.zh: : （在内心尖叫，而且发情了）

lines.en: : Is there a problem?
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : ....{i}Nope!{/i} Just a cramp in my arm! Don’t mind me!
lines.zh: : ……{i}没有！{/i}只是手臂抽筋了！别管我！

lines.en: : Anyway, if you’re not going to get in with me, you should probably dry yourself off. There’s no way it’s comfortable being in those clothes right now.
lines.zh: : 总之，您要是不进来一起泡，就该把身上擦干。穿着那身衣服现在肯定不舒服。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel24
: It’s no biggie. I used to play in the rain a lot when I was little, so feeling like this is actually a big ole’ nostalgia trip for me right now.
lines.zh: : 没什么大不了的。我小时候经常在雨里玩，所以现在这种感觉对我还挺怀旧的。

lines.en: : It’s really only my underwear and socks that bother me when they’re wet and I already took those off like a minute ago.
lines.zh: : 湿了之后真正让我难受的其实只有内衣和袜子，而我大概一分钟前就把那两样脱了。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel25
: Is that what you were doing when you made me look away?
lines.zh: : 您让我转过头去的时候，就是在干这个？

lines.en: : What’s this? You actually {i}looked away?{/i} Who knows when the next chance you’ll get to see me in that state is, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哎呀？您居然真的{i}转过头了{/i}？谁知道您下一次有机会看到我那个样子是什么时候呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : I’m sure the day will come. I’m surprised you’re just...okay with talking about that, though.
lines.zh: : 我相信那一天会来的。不过我挺意外，您居然……能这么坦然地聊这个。

lines.en: : Why? Are you getting excited?
lines.zh: : 为什么？您兴奋了？

lines.en: : Would you join me if I was?
lines.zh: : 如果我兴奋了，您会进来一起泡吗？

lines.en: : I’d have to make a phone call first.
lines.zh: : 那我得先打个电话。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel26
: If that is what must be done, so be it. Just maybe don’t mention my age. Or my job. Or even my appearance as I don’t want your parents trying to track me down.
lines.zh: : 非打不可的话，那就打吧。只是别提我的年龄。也别提我的工作。甚至连我的长相都别提，我可不想让您爸妈顺藤摸瓜找我。

lines.en: : I’m not telling anybody anything, Sensei. Don’t you worry.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不会跟别人说的，Sensei。您别担心。

lines.en: : What matters now is enjoying our time here before the rain stops.
lines.zh: : 现在重要的是在雨停之前好好享受我们在这儿的时间。

lines.en: : This is all just one more cliche we’ll scratch into our memory books. And when we look back on it years from now, if you’re still putting up with me then, I’m sure we’ll laugh.
lines.zh: : 这一切不过又是一个可以刻进我们纪念册的老套桥段。多年以后回头看——如果那时候您还受得了我——我敢说我们一定会笑。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel27
: Unless you and Io really {i}do{/i} run away, that is. Which you shouldn’t, because losing both of you at once would make it hard for even me to keep on smiling.
lines.zh: : 当然，除非您和 Io 真的{i}私奔{/i}了。不过您不该那么做，因为一下子失去你们两个，连我都没法继续笑着了。

lines.en: : Maybe I will? I bet {i}Io{/i} would get in the bath with me.
lines.zh: : 也许我会呢？我敢说{i}Io{/i}会跟我一起泡澡。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel28
: PFFFT! HAHAHAHA! HAHAHA!
lines.zh: : 噗！哈哈哈哈哈！哈哈哈！

lines.en: : ...Did I say something funny?
lines.zh: : ……我说什么好笑的话了吗？

lines.en: scene utalovehotel29
: Oh, no! No no no! I shouldn’t have laughed there! I’m sorry! It wasn’t funny.
lines.zh: : 哦，不！不不不！我不该笑的！对不起！那不好笑。

lines.en: : That just...it took me by surprise, that’s all. I wasn’t like...doubting you or anything.
lines.zh: : 只是……我太意外了，就这样。我并没有……怀疑您什么的。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel30
: I, uhh...{i}would{/i} like to hear why you think that, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我，呃……{i}确实{/i}想听听您为什么那么想。

lines.en: : Unless it’s something you don’t want to talk about. Which, if it is, we can go back to being silent and listening to all of the other couples have sex.
lines.zh: : 除非那是您不想谈的事。如果是的话，我们可以回到沉默，继续听其他情侣做爱。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel31

: Oh! And when I say “other” couples, I’m not implying that {i}we’re{/i} a couple. No way. We’re just two people stuck inside a room full of condoms, trying to keep each other comfortable without using any!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有，我说“其他”情侣的时候，可不是在暗示{i}我们{/i}是一对。怎么可能。我们只是两个被困在一屋子避孕套里的人，努力让对方舒服点，而且一个都不用！

lines.en: : Classic Uta-Sensei relationship, right?!
lines.zh: : 典型的 Uta 与 Sensei 关系，对吧？！

lines.en: : Please talk. You’re making me feel like I made a huge mistake just now.
lines.zh: : 求您说话吧。您这样让我觉得自己刚才犯了个天大的错。

lines.en: : I just think you’re acting a little weird, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得您表现得有点奇怪，就这样。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel32
: Well...just...
: What makes you think Io would do something like that?
lines.zh: : 您凭什么觉得 Io 会做那种事？

lines.en: : You...know you can like somebody without wanting to get in their pants, right?
lines.zh: : 您……知道喜欢一个人，不一定要想钻进对方裤子里吧？

lines.en: : But that’s the best part.
lines.zh: : 可那是最好的部分啊。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel33
: Not everybody’s like that, Sensei. Some people just want somebody they can be close to or...somebody they don’t get bored of.
lines.zh: : 不是每个人都那样的，Sensei。有些人只是想要一个能亲近的人，或者……一个不会让自己腻烦的人。

lines.en: : I’m sure there are plenty of girls in the class, cough cough Ami, who’d be happy to jump your bones, but you’re smarter than expecting {i}everybody{/i} to just be on board right away, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 我敢说班上有很多女孩——咳咳，Ami——会很乐意扑上去，不过您总不至于傻到指望{i}所有人{/i}都马上就同意吧？

lines.en: : Of course I am. For example, I know {i}you’re{/i} in no rush to “jump my bones,” which is why I’m able to constantly joke about it the way I do.
lines.zh: : 我当然不至于。比如说，我知道{i}您{/i}并不急着“扑上来”，所以我也才能一直拿这事开玩笑。

lines.en: : Hahah...yeah...funny jokes...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……是啊……玩笑真好笑……

lines.en: scene utalovehotel34
: I can’t accurately judge everyone, though. So if you know something I don’t know and are at liberty to share it, I implore you to do so.
lines.zh: : 不过我没法把每个人都判断准。所以如果您知道些我不知道的事，又能说，就拜托您告诉我。

lines.en: : Those are dangerous words to say to a girl who’s notoriously bad with secrets, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 对一个出名的藏不住秘密的女孩说这种话，可是很危险的，Sensei。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel35
: But...umm...for your sake...and because we need more stuff to talk about so all of those couples in the other rooms don’t start makin’ me feel some kind of way...
lines.zh: : 不过……嗯……看在您的份上……也因为我们需要更多话题，免得其他房间那些情侣的声音让我开始有某种感觉……

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : Well, I wouldn’t get my hopes up if I were you. Least not until you know for sure.
lines.zh: : 嗯，换作是您，我不会抱太大希望。至少在您确定之前别抱。

lines.en: : Last thing you wanna do is make a move too early and scare somebody off, you know.
lines.zh: : 您最不想看到的，就是出手太早把人吓跑，您知道的。

lines.en: : How early is too early?
lines.zh: : 多早算太早？

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 这个……

lines.en: : That depends on the girl, I guess...
lines.zh: : 这得看是哪个女孩吧……

lines.en: : How early would be too early for you?
lines.zh: : 那对您来说，多早算太早？

lines.en: scene utalovehotel34
scene utalovehotel36
: Oh! My phone! And at the worst possible time!
lines.zh: : 哦！我的手机！而且还是最糟的时机！

lines.en: : Welp, better go answer it!
lines.zh: : 唉，还是去接吧！

lines.en: scene black
: Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : S-Sorry, Sensei! It could be important! Like...maybe it’s front desk apologizing for overstocking the condoms?! Or maybe it’s...my mom calling to check in! Yeah! That’s probably it!
lines.zh: : 对、对不起，Sensei！可能很重要呢！比如……也许是前台来为避孕套备货过多道歉？！或者……是我妈打来问候！对！大概就是这个！

lines.en: scene utalovehotel37
: Don’t worry, though! I won’t tell them that we’re in a love hotel! And we don’t have to worry about her asking me to send a picture of where I am either since I still can’t send picture messages!
lines.zh: : 不过别担心！我不会告诉他们我们在情人酒店的！而且也不用担心她让我发张照片报位置，因为我还发不了图片消息呢！

lines.en: : If you didn’t want to answer the question, all you had to do was say so.
lines.zh: : 你要是不想回答那个问题，直说就行了。

lines.en: : What question? Did you ask me a question? I don’t remember any questions.
lines.zh: : 什么问题？您问我问题了吗？我不记得有什么问题。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel38
: Anyway, phone time! Don’t answer any of the things I just said.
lines.zh: : 总之，接电话时间到！我刚才说的那些您都别回答。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel39
: I hope you’re planning on making it up to me when you get back in here. Being neglected in favor of a mysterious text message is not typical maid behavior.
lines.zh: : 我希望你回来之后打算好好补偿我。为了一条来路不明的短信就把我晾在一边，可不是标准女仆的行为。

lines.en: : You literally asked me to be normal Uta like five minutes ago. Stop being so needy.
lines.zh: : 您明明五分钟前才让我当普通的 Uta。别这么黏人。

lines.en: scene utalovehotel40
scene utalovehotel41
scene utalovehotel42

lines.zh: : Uta？……

lines.en: : {i}Something came up!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}出了点事！{/i}

lines.en: scene black
A voice shouts back at me from outside of the door, overpowering the endless medley of orgasms that have all but lost their impact by now.
lines.zh: 一个声音从门外喊回来给我回应，盖过了那没完没了的高潮合奏——那些声音到这会儿早就没了冲击力。

lines.en: I can not hear Uta run away, but I know that she does.
lines.zh: 我听不见 Uta 跑开的声音，但我知道她跑了。

lines.en: I finish bathing and hang my clothes up to dry on an old towel rack.
lines.zh: 我洗完澡，把衣服挂在旧毛巾架上晾着。

lines.en: When I return to bed to kill time while waiting for the rain to stop, I notice something out of the corner of my eye.
lines.zh: 我回到床上，打算打发时间等雨停，这时余光瞥见了什么东西。

lines.en: A maroon pair of panties, wet from the rain and lustful teen martyrdom.
lines.zh: 一条紫红色的内裤，被雨水、以及少女情欲的殉道浸得湿透。

lines.en: I lift them off of the ground.
lines.zh: 我把它们从地上捡起来。

lines.en: And I dirty them.
lines.zh: 然后我把它们弄脏了。

lines.en: Repeatedly.
lines.zh: 反复地。

lines.en: Until the rain stops.
lines.zh: 直到雨停。
